name: Temporary WP-MVP-0005 reconcile current main

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ops/wp-mvp-0005-reconcile-433bde

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  reconcile:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out product branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: wp/mvp-0005
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Merge current canonical main
        run: |
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "433bdebd4ff4a4a284ea58ef5dc277997f59c448"
          set +e
          git merge --no-commit --no-ff origin/main
          status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            conflicts="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"
            test -n "$conflicts"
            while IFS= read -r path; do
              case "$path" in
                machine/*)
                  git checkout --theirs -- "$path"
                  git add -- "$path"
                  ;;
                *)
                  echo "Unexpected non-derived merge conflict: $path" >&2
                  exit 1
                  ;;
              esac
            done <<< "$conflicts"
          fi
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"

      - name: Format and validate monad-core on combined tree
        run: |
          cargo fmt --all
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test -p monad-core
          cargo clippy -p monad-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A clippy::large_enum_variant
          git diff --check -- crates/monad-core/src/

      - name: Regenerate combined deterministic projections
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Validate combined governed tree
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Commit reconciliation
        run: |
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --check -- crates/monad-core/src/
          git commit -m "chore(core): reconcile WP-MVP-0005 with current canonical main"
          git push origin HEAD:wp/mvp-0005
